He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball|Rutgers Scarlet Knights]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2024 class. ==Early life and high school career== Bailey grew up in [[Chattanooga, Tennessee]], and initially attended [[Boyd-Buchanan School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.timesfreepress.com/news/2021/jan/11/prep-roundup-freshman-bailey-helps-spark-boy/|title=Prep roundup: Freshman Ace Bailey helps spark Boyd Buchanan past region rival|work=[[Chattanooga Times Free Press]]|date=January 11, 2021|access-date=November 12, 2023}} After his freshman year, he moved to [[Powder Springs, Georgia]] and enrolled at [[McEachern High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.onthebanks.com/2023/11/12/23957630/5-star-forward-ace-bailey-officially-signs-nli-with-rutgers|title=5-Star Forward Ace Bailey Officially Signs NLI with Rutgers|first=John|last=Catapano|website=OnTheBanks.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=Nov 12, 2023|access-date=November 14, 2023}} Bailey averaged 22 points, 14 rebounds, three assists, and four blocks per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://rutgers.rivals.com/news/rutgers-scarlet-knights-basketball-signee-bio-f-ace-bailey|title=Rutgers Scarlet Knights Basketball Signee Bio: F Ace Bailey|first=Richard|last=Schnyderite|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=November 12, 2023|access-date=November 15, 2023}} He improved his stats to 32.5 points, 15.5 rebounds, 3.5 assists, and 2.4 blocks per game as a senior. Bailey was selected to play in the [[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2024 McDonald's All-American Game]], [[Jordan Brand Classic]], and [[Nike Hoop Summit]] during his senior year.
